items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: we've been friends a while and he always told me if you ever get a chance, you're on record.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Who was the guy? Who was the guy that owned it?
Uh, Janellis. Janellis. Janellis. Who was his name? Janellis, yeah. We never did do anything with the numbers. Poor fella died before we got a chance to do anything. Yeah.
I want to tell them about what happened to those records. Yeah. When the guy died and everything. Or why he died. What happened?
